verbatim_quote.original: Please issue the final closure XML so the Hands can execute the closure sequence exactly once: move the task file to tasks/completed/, set Status: closed, update the **File:** header to the completed path, re-lint, and commit via custom_context_commit_and_clean_task (the only commit path; ZAC forbids git commit).
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Please issue the final closure XML so the Hands can execute the closure sequence exactly once: move the task file to tasks/completed/, set Status: closed, update the **File:** header to the completed path, re-lint, and commit via custom_context_commit_and_clean_task (the only commit path; ZAC forbids git commit).

extracted_decision.summary: Execute the closure sequence exactly once: move task file to tasks/completed/, set Status: closed, update File header to completed path, re-lint, and commit only via custom_context_commit_and_clean_task; ZAC forbids git commit.
extracted_decision.rationale: Ensure closure is atomic, compliant with Zero-Autonomous-Commit (ZAC), and uses the approved MCP commit path rather than raw git.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Restricts Hands to one commit path and one execution, reducing risk of duplicate or non-compliant commits, but requires precise step ordering.
